# source: EXTERNAL, not from the game files. Pokemon Showdown data/moves.ts (MIT) at commit bc281dae0e46e8a5edc03db4c4b914fe8818dde6; names cross-checked against https://www.wikidex.net/wiki/Lista_de_movimientos
# semantics: one row per move; numeric fields as published by Showdown (accuracy 101 = never misses, as in
#   data/pml_moves.tsv). drain/recoil/heal are percents; recoil_pct is kept apart from drain_pct.
#   sec_* = secondary effect of the hit, self_boosts = boosts the user gets, boosts = status-move boosts
#   (stat keys atk/def/spa/spd/spe/accuracy/evasion). callbacks = behaviour hooks Showdown attaches;
#   other_props = remaining Showdown properties with no engine column. source_diff = stat values where
#   WikiDex disagrees with Showdown (WikiDex footnotes give the value before Pokemon Champions).
# classification (DERIVED, not data): engine_class a = expressible with the existing pml_move_effects
#   columns (24 moves), b = needs new engine logic (46 moves); engine_reason lists why.
# confidence: EXTERNAL; not verified against PLA. Do not mix with pml_moves rows.
